name: UT AI agent
description: AI agent sample: given a request about an invoice line, it uses the agent UT API agent as its tool and returns the total and currency as output fields.

variables.name: request
variables.description: What the agent is asked to do this time.

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: The local stand-in that plays the model.

variables.name: api_key
variables.description: Made-up key for the stand-in model.

variables.name: status
variables.description: completed, limit_reached, stopped, failed or cancelled.

variables.name: outputs
variables.description: The output fields total and currency.

variables.name: trace
variables.description: Each model turn and tool call.

steps.description: Plan with the model and call UT API agent as a tool

args.instructions: You are a careful accounts assistant. Use the tools to work out figures; never invent results.
args.action_plan: 1. Call the total tool with the quantity and unit price. 2. Report the total and the currency.

output_fields.total: the invoice line total as a number
